value.name: pring_ai_mcp_client_jira_mcp_server_jira_getIssueDevelopmentInfo
value.description: Get linked development information (pull requests, commits, or branches) shown in the Development panel of a JIRA issue in the JIRA Data Center edition instance. Defaults to pull requests from Bitbucket.

value.name: spring_ai_mcp_client_jira_mcp_server_jira_transitionIssue
value.description: Transition a JIRA issue to a new status in the JIRA Data Center edition instance. Use jira_getTransitions first to get available transition IDs.

value.name: spring_ai_mcp_client_jira_mcp_server_jira_getIssueLinkTypes
value.description: Get the list of available issue link types (e.g. Blocks, Relates, Duplicate) in the JIRA Data Center edition instance. Use this to discover valid link type names before calling jira_linkIssues.

value.name: spring_ai_mcp_client_jira_mcp_server_jira_linkIssues
value.description: Create a link between two JIRA issues in the JIRA Data Center edition instance. Direction is easy to invert vs the Jira UI: inwardIssueKey is the issue that DISPLAYS the outward phrase (e.g. 'blocks'); outwardIssueKey displays the inward phrase (e.g. 'is blocked by'). After create, GET the first issue √¢‚?¨‚?ù it must have outwardIssue = the second key. Use jira_getIssueLinkTypes for valid type names.

value.name: spring_ai_mcp_client_jira_mcp_server_jira_unlinkIssues
value.description: Delete an existing link between two JIRA issues in the JIRA Data Center edition instance. Requires the issue link id (found in the 'issuelinks' field of an issue).

value.name: spring_ai_mcp_client_jira_mcp_server_jira_downloadAttachment
value.description: Download attachment(s) from a JIRA issue in the JIRA Data Center edition instance, by issue key (optionally filtered by filename) or by a single attachment id. Returns the file content inline (base64 or text). Useful for inspecting a file or moving it elsewhere (e.g. re-uploading to a Confluence page). Saving to local disk is disabled on this server.
